quest.title: Miracle Medicine
quest.description: Anthony requested a prescription from a master physician in Liyue Harbor that can be used to heal Anna.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Yes, well, I guess I was just giving myself a fright.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Anna's looking better by the day. This doctor really is the real deal.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: If you're willing, could you help me find more ingredients? This time, we need a Wind-Caressed Aster.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Well, Windwheel Asters are sometimes used in medicine, but it's usually used to heal minor ailments.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Maybe the Anemo Slime is the key, but Windwheel Asters and Anemo Slimes aren't really seen together often.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Luckily, Jack has seen this happen a few times before, and he has related their rough locations to me. Let me mark the latest one out on your map.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I can't deal with Anemo Slimes since they can fly, so I can only turn to you!

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I wouldn't argue with you, but Windwheel Asters and Anemo Slimes aren't seen together often.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Fortunately, Jack has seen this happen a few times before, and he has related their rough locations to me. Let me mark the latest one out on your map.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I really can't fight Anemo Slimes, since they can fly, so I can only count on you!

choices.text: I'll just catch an Anemo Slime for you.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: You just want to watch me embarrass myself, don't you?

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Nonetheless, Windwheel Asters and Anemo Slimes aren't seen together often.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Fortunately, Jack has seen this happen a few times before, and he has related their rough locations to me. Let me mark the latest one out on your map.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: If you really can't find it, then bring an Anemo Slime back. I'll do anything for Anna.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Well, it is combat we're talking about. Take some time to prepare, and I'll see you again.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Huh. This Windwheel Aster does feel different from normal.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Hahaha. Don't ask me why, but I have a feeling that if Anna eats this medicine, she will certainly get well.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Maybe her recent improvement's been getting my hopes up.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: All the same, thank you so much. Take this as compensation for your trouble.
